## Implementation Tasks

- [x] Task 1: Add or centralize dependency target classification for queued, in-flight, archived, and missing dependency IDs using repository-visible active change directories, in-flight IDs, and archive entries. (verification: unit - implementation in `src/dependency_targets.rs`; tests `dependency_targets::tests::classifies_dependency_targets_from_supplied_evidence` and `dependency_targets::tests::strips_date_prefixed_archive_names`; runnable command: `cargo test dependency_targets --lib`)
- [x] Task 2: Update analyzer result handling so `Change.dependencies` metadata is unioned into `AnalysisResult.dependencies` for normal LLM output, single-change fast paths, and parse-success paths without removing LLM-discovered valid dependencies. (verification: unit - implementation in `src/analyzer.rs`; tests `analyzer::tests::test_single_change_fast_path_preserves_metadata_dependency`, `analyzer::tests::test_parse_response_unions_metadata_dependency_omitted_by_llm`, and `dependency_targets::tests::unions_metadata_dependencies_without_removing_existing_dependencies`; runnable commands: `cargo test test_single_change_fast_path_preserves_metadata_dependency --lib`, `cargo test test_parse_response_unions_metadata_dependency_omitted_by_llm --lib`, and `cargo test unions_metadata_dependencies_without_removing_existing_dependencies --lib`)
- [x] Task 3: Update LLM analysis fallback in `src/parallel_run_service.rs` so fallback analysis is metadata-dependency-only rather than dependency-free. (verification: unit - implementation in `src/parallel_run_service.rs`; test `parallel_run_service::tests::test_analyze_order_fallback_preserves_metadata_dependencies_when_llm_disabled`; runnable command: `cargo test test_analyze_order_fallback_preserves_metadata_dependencies_when_llm_disabled --lib`)
- [x] Task 4: Update analyzer dependency validation so archived dependency targets are allowed as satisfied references while missing targets still produce dedicated dependency diagnostics instead of generic JSON/parse failures. (verification: unit - implementation in `src/analyzer.rs`; tests `analyzer::tests::test_validate_dependency_graph_accepts_archived_dependency`, `analyzer::tests::test_validate_dependency_graph_reports_missing_dependency`, and `analyzer::tests::test_decorate_dependency_error_classifies_archived_dependency`; runnable commands: `cargo test test_validate_dependency_graph_accepts_archived_dependency --lib`, `cargo test test_validate_dependency_graph_reports_missing_dependency --lib`, and `cargo test test_decorate_dependency_error_classifies_archived_dependency --lib`)
- [x] Task 5: Update dispatch-time dependency checks in `src/parallel/queue_state.rs` so queued/in-flight dependencies block until merged to base, archived dependencies are treated as resolved, and missing dependencies fail closed without dispatch. (verification: integration - implementation in `src/parallel/queue_state.rs`; tests `parallel::tests::executor::test_inflight_dependency_blocks_dispatch_until_resolved`, `parallel::tests::executor::test_archived_dependency_is_satisfied_without_rejection`, and `parallel::tests::executor::test_missing_dependency_fails_closed_without_dispatch`; runnable commands: `cargo test test_inflight_dependency_blocks_dispatch_until_resolved --lib`, `cargo test test_archived_dependency_is_satisfied_without_rejection --lib`, and `cargo test test_missing_dependency_fails_closed_without_dispatch --lib`)
- [x] Task 6: Ensure user-facing events/logs distinguish dependency blocked, archived/satisfied dependency, and missing dependency cases without marking archived dependencies as rejected. (verification: integration - implementation in `src/parallel/queue_state.rs`; tests `parallel::tests::executor::test_inflight_dependency_blocks_dispatch_until_resolved` asserts `DependencyBlocked`, `parallel::tests::executor::test_archived_dependency_is_satisfied_without_rejection` asserts no `ChangeRejected`, and `parallel::tests::executor::test_missing_dependency_fails_closed_without_dispatch` asserts a missing-dependency `ExecutionEvent::Error`; runnable command: `cargo test 'test_inflight_dependency_blocks_dispatch_until_resolved|test_archived_dependency_is_satisfied_without_rejection|test_missing_dependency_fails_closed_without_dispatch' --lib`)
- [x] Task 7: Run targeted regression checks for analyzer and parallel scheduler dependency handling. (verification: integration - runnable targeted commands are `cargo test analyzer --lib`, `cargo test dependency_targets --lib`, `cargo test test_analyze_order_fallback_preserves_metadata_dependencies_when_llm_disabled --lib`, `cargo test test_inflight_dependency_blocks_dispatch_until_resolved --lib`, `cargo test test_archived_dependency_is_satisfied_without_rejection --lib`, and `cargo test test_missing_dependency_fails_closed_without_dispatch --lib`)

## Final Validation

Archive validation itself is the authoritative final OpenSpec validation gate.
Expected archive gate: `cflx openspec validate fix-dependency-target-handling --archive-gate`

## Acceptance #1 Failure Follow-up

Acceptance #1 found that the archive gate required concrete repository-verifiable evidence in task verification notes. Task 1, Task 4, Task 5, and Task 6 now cite concrete source paths, test names, and runnable commands.

Acceptance #1 also found that the targeted regression command in `tasks.md` was not runnable as written because Cargo accepts only one `TESTNAME` before `--`. Task 7 now lists runnable targeted commands separately.

## Acceptance #2 Failure Follow-up

Acceptance #2 found that the archive gate treated the follow-up checklist itself as behavior-bearing tasks without verification notes. This section is intentionally non-checklist prose so archive validation only evaluates the implementation tasks above.

Archive-gate follow-up resolution: `tasks.md` now avoids unchecked follow-up checklist items that describe validation work without `(verification: ...)` notes. Verification owner: final archive validation via `cflx openspec validate fix-dependency-target-handling --archive-gate`.

Runnable-command follow-up resolution: Task 7 lists separate runnable cargo commands instead of a single regex command after Cargo's `TESTNAME` argument. Previously sampled targeted commands `agent-exec run -- cargo test analyzer --lib` and `agent-exec run -- cargo test dependency_targets --lib` both exited with code 0.
